name: Goddamn & Je t'Aime
original_name: ガッデーム＆ジュテーム
source:
Anger management is far from Takamatsu-kun's forte when he can only express his rage in base-2—GODDAMN when he's real pissed and JE T'AIME when he's just regular old mad. Countless wacky situations lie ahead for Takamatsu and his odd neighbors, "sisters" Yamada and Tanaka.

With an average playtime of 2 hours per run, get judged at the end based on how many times you picked GODDAMN or JE T'AIME.
translation:
高松根本不擅长控制愤怒，因为他只会用二进制方式表达怒火：真正暴怒时说“GODDAMN”，只是一般生气时说“JE T’AIME”。等待高松和奇怪邻居——自称“姐妹”的山田与田中——的是数不清的荒诞状况。

每轮游戏平均耗时两小时。结局时，系统会根据你选择“GODDAMN”或“JE T’AIME”的次数作出评价。
